parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability (CWE-78: OS Command Injection) does not apply to the given code fragment. The code does not execute any commands; it only decodes a base64-encoded string and sets it to the clipboard as text data.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code does not execute any commands. It only decodes a base64-encoded string and sets it to the clipboard as text data. There is no mechanism in the code that would allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary commands.
